system.description: The builder has used the spell Outside Worlds Within (see The White Treatise, pp. 77-78) to turn part of the manse into a bit of the outdoors, though the area actually remains bounded by the manse's walls. Tying the enchantment to the manse's geomancy makes it permanent. Other magic might create pocket environments such as paintings you can step into and they become real, or similar wonders. Unlike the Palace of Unreality (see below), everything in Outside Worlds Within is quite real—though it cannot leave the manse.
